pokedexEntries.ru: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.

pokedexEntries.sa: REGISTEEL was imprisoned by people in ancient times. The metal composing its body is thought to be a curious substance that is not of this earth.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.

pokedexEntries.em: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
